== Summary ==
Players Committee D-E1 card image of For Luck, shown on [[For Luck (PC 2023 D-E1 card)]] (and as the card picture on [[For Luck (Decipher Errata 2002)]]). Source: Holotable image <code>Images-HT/starwars/JediPack-Light/large/forluck.gif</code>; high-resolution PNG first committed in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/01a23fd9c008e5b6aff64fb1a9467372a7228b41 swccgpc/holotable commit 01a23fd] (“Remastered Decipher Errata F”, 31 March 2023, UTC). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122140307/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/01a23fd9c008e5b6aff64fb1a9467372a7228b41 Internet Archive]; card-size GIF in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/15fe0698ce5c2eed581ddf1a3f1088c631618c40 swccgpc/holotable commit 15fe069] (“Fixing case and making gifs”, 1 April 2023, UTC). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122134204/https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/15fe0698ce5c2eed581ddf1a3f1088c631618c40 Internet Archive]. The PC served the image at [https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/JediPack-Light/large/forluck.gif forluck.gif]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261009030422/https://res.starwarsccg.org/cards/JediPack-Light/large/forluck.gif Internet Archive] (9 October 2026).
